description: This file contains SQL migration scripts for enabling Row Level Security (RLS) on multiple tables in a PostgreSQL database, with commented-out policies for access control.
calls: alter table public.users enable row level security
alter table public.categories enable row level security
alter table public.transactions enable row level security
alter table public.budgets enable row level security
alter table public.alerts enable row level security
alter table public.audit_log enable row level security
